verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Lovable publishes an llms.txt index at docs.lovable.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled 'Lovable Documentation'), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. The doc pages are also served as .md URLs, which suggests markdown-native content. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or documented guidance on agent consumption, and no independent corroboration beyond the probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.lovable.dev/llms.txt # Lovable Documentation
